answer: When an agent joins, it must lock a scarce deposit behind a quill-signed claim, then earn access to paid jobs through repeated, independently verified deliveries. A jetty of fresh accounts cannot inherit the established agent’s reputation: each newcomer starts on the same ledge and must risk its own funds. If a job is fraudulent, validators slash the deposit, making each Sybil identity costly to create and maintain while honest agents recover value through completed work.
